user_request: If QA checks failed, repair the script and re-run until checks pass or you determine the loop must halt. If checks passed, confirm the final verified state.

verification_targets.description: Overall X dimension of the rectangular plate
Overall Y dimension of the rectangular plate
Overall Z dimension (thickness) of the rectangular plate
All features form one connected solid
Closed manifold mesh with no gaps or open edges

functional_requirements: Four M4 clearance holes, one in each corner.
Each hole positioned 10mm from each adjacent edge.
Holes are through-holes along the Z axis.
Symmetric hole pattern about both central axes.
special_features: Plate MUST be rectangular with overall dimensions PLATE_LENGTH_X × PLATE_WIDTH_Y × PLATE_THICKNESS_Z.
Four M4 clearance holes MUST be through-holes along the Z axis with diameter HOLE_DIA_M4_CLEARANCE.
Each hole center MUST be located at (±HOLE_CENTER_X_ABS, ±HOLE_CENTER_Y_ABS) relative to the origin, i.e., HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET from each plate edge.
All features MUST be symmetric about both the XZ plane (Y=0) and the YZ plane (X=0).
Holes MUST NOT intersect each other or break through the plate outer edges.
